why: Not a single reviewer, major or niche, appears in the results. Five of the twelve slots are blank or blocked (four Vuextend pages and two empty Best Buy pages), and the rest are single-product retailer listings (Best Buy INVZI, Walmart NGTeco and FORKA) or FOPO's own store page with a fake 50% discount. Nothing compares models, nothing tests, and nothing addresses the real pitfalls (MacBook compatibility, power, weight). A focused page comparing the 16-inch 1920x1200 triple extenders with current prices, tested codes (FOPO already shows one) and a direct pick would be the only comparison in the set.
